verdict.rationale: Saved reply templates and snippets are a fair axis for an email client, but the evidence pack never mentions Outlook templates, snippets, or variables. The Graph API's ability to draft messages and add attachments is a developer building block, not the user-facing template capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
